additional_info.subject: Error Control
additional_info.body: Hi Fosco, the charger having trouble grouping the converter and DC2 is off time to time. I thought this might be related to the "Power Saving Mode" and asked the customer to turn it off. I'd like you to check it out as well.

additional_info.subject: 0454525 - ID0454525-DC/Si-D/TR- [MP / P1 170000412] Faulted Connector CRM:00458000008
additional_info.body:
Hi Ms İrem,
An issue has been identified that triggers other errors with PowerSave Mode on this device. For now, disabled PowerSave mode by you. After that, the charger is working and there is charge process on the Outlet-3 (DC2)
Fix is already under progress and will be released with v9.X.
We will proceed to close this ticket.
